# Imaginated

> Free online photography education platform specializing in portrait photography analysis, lighting techniques, and composition fundamentals.

Imaginated offers comprehensive guides and tutorials for learning photography through detailed image analysis and critiques. The site focuses heavily on portrait photography, covering essential techniques like lighting setups, composition principles, and color harmony.

## Key Topics

- Portrait Photography
- Golden Hour
- Lighting Techniques
- Rule of Thirds
- Rembrandt Lighting
- Composition Analysis
- Color Harmony
- Headshot Photography
- Golden Ratio
- Loop Lighting
- Split Lighting
- Soft Lighting
- Natural Light
- Depth of Field
- Leading Lines

## Core & Getting Started

- [Imaginated Homepage](https://www.imaginated.com): Learn photography online free with guides, tutorials, and interviews
